transcript.en: One of the most famous cases of extinction is that of a bird known as the dodo. In fact there's even a saying in English, 'as dead as the dodo', used to refer to something which no longer exists.
transcript.zh: 最著名的动物灭绝案例之一就是一种被称为渡渡鸟的鸟类。其实，英语中甚至有一句谚语，“像渡渡鸟一样死透了”，用来指不再存在的事物。

transcript.en: But for many centuries the dodo was alive and well, although it could only be found in one place, the island of Mauritius in the Indian Ocean.
transcript.zh: 但是几百年来，渡渡鸟都活得好好的，尽管它只能在一个地方被发现，就是印度洋的毛里求斯岛。

transcript.en: It was a very large bird, about one metre tall, and over the centuries it had lost the ability to fly,
transcript.zh: 这是一种非常大型的鸟，大约一米高，几个世纪以来，它已经失去了飞行的能力，

transcript.en: but it survived happily under the trees that covered the island.
transcript.zh: 但它在覆盖了整个小岛的树木下快乐地生存了下来。

transcript.en: Then in the year 1507 the first Portuguese ships stopped at the island. The sailors were carrying spices back to Europe,
transcript.zh: 然后在1507这一年，第一批葡萄牙船只停泊在岛上。水手们带着香料回到了欧洲，

transcript.en: and found the island a convenient stopping place where they could stock up with food and water for the rest of the voyage, but they didn't settle on Mauritius.
transcript.zh: 同时发现这个岛屿是一个方便的停留地，他们可以在那里为接下来的航行储备食物和水，但他们并没有在毛里求斯定居。

transcript.en: However, in 1638 the Dutch arrived and set up a colony there.
transcript.zh: 然而，在1638年的时候荷兰人来到这里，并在那里建立了殖民地。

transcript.en: These first human inhabitants of the island found the dodo birds a convenient source of meat, although not everyone liked the taste.
transcript.zh: 这些岛上的第一批人类居民发现渡渡鸟是一种方便的肉类来源，尽管不是每个人都喜欢这种味道。

transcript.en: It's hard to get an accurate description of what the dodo actually looked like.
transcript.zh: 很难准确描述渡渡鸟的真实模样。

transcript.en: We do have some written records from sailors, and a few pictures, but we don't know how reliable these are.
transcript.zh: 我们的确有一些水手的书面记录和一些照片，但我们不知道这些记录的可靠程度。

transcript.en: The best-known picture is a Dutch painting in which the bird appears to be extremely fat,
transcript.zh: 最著名的是荷兰的一幅画作，画中的鸟看起来非常胖，

transcript.en: but this may not be accurate - an Indian painting done at the same time shows a much thinner bird.
transcript.zh: 但这可能不准确——同时期完成的一幅印度作品描绘了一只比较瘦的鸟。

transcript.en: Although attempts were made to preserve the bodies of some of the birds, no complete specimen survives.
transcript.zh: 尽管人们试图保存一部分鸟类的尸体，但并没有完整的标本幸存下来。

transcript.en: In the early 17th century four dried parts of a bird were known to exist - of these, three have disappeared,
transcript.zh: 在17世纪早期，人们了解到有一只鸟的四个脱水干燥部位确实存在——单其中的三个部分已经消失不见了，

transcript.en: so only one example of soft tissue from the dodo survives, a dodo head.
transcript.zh: 所以只有一个软组织幸存下来，一个渡渡鸟头。

transcript.en: Bones have also been found, but there's only one complete skeleton in existence.
transcript.zh: 骨头也被发现了，但只有一个完整的骨骼存在。

transcript.en: This single dodo skeleton has recently been the subject of scientific research which suggests that many of the earlier beliefs about dodos may have been incorrect.
transcript.zh: 这只渡渡鸟骨架最近成为了科学研究的对象，这表明许多早期关于渡渡鸟的看法可能是不正确的。

transcript.en: For example, early accounts of the birds mention how slow and clumsy it was,
transcript.zh: 例如，早期对鸟类的描述提到了它是多么的缓慢和笨拙，

transcript.en: but scientists now believe the bird's strong knee joints would have made it capable of movement which was not slow, but actually quite fast.
transcript.zh: 但是科学家们现在认为，这种鸟的强壮的膝关节会使它能够进行不仅不慢，实际上却相当快的动作。

transcript.en: In fact, one 17th century sailor wrote that he found the birds hard to catch.
transcript.zh: 事实上，一位17世纪的水手写道，他发现这些鸟很难捕捉。

transcript.en: It's true that the dodo's small wings wouldn't have allowed it to leave the ground,
transcript.zh: 的确，渡渡鸟的小翅膀无法使它离开地面，

transcript.en: but the scientists suggest that these were probably employed for balance while going over uneven ground.
transcript.zh: 但是科学家们认为，小翅膀可能是用来在崎岖不平的地面上保持平衡用的。

transcript.en: Another group of scientists carried out analysis of the dodo's skull.
transcript.zh: 另一组科学家对渡渡鸟的头骨进行了分析。

transcript.en: They found that the reports of the lack of intelligence of the dodo were not borne out by their research,
transcript.zh: 他们发现有关渡渡鸟缺乏智力的说法无法被证实，

transcript.en: which suggested the bird's brain was not small, but average in size.
transcript.zh: 他们的研究结果表明，渡渡鸟的大脑并不小，而是中等规模。

transcript.en: In fact, in relation to its body size, it was similar to that of the pigeon, which is known to be a highly intelligent bird.
transcript.zh: 事实上，就其体型而言，它与鸽子的脑部尺寸很相似，而众所周知鸽子是一种非常聪明的鸟。

transcript.en: The researchers also found that the structure of the bird's skull suggested that one sense which was particularly well-developed was that of smell.
transcript.zh: 研究人员还发现，这种鸟的头骨结构表明，它的嗅觉是特别发达的。

transcript.en: So the dodo may also have been particularly good at locating ripe fruit and other food in the island's thick vegetation.
transcript.zh: 因此，渡渡鸟也在岛上厚厚的植被中可能会特别擅长寻找成熟的水果和其他食物。

transcript.en: So it looks as if the dodo was better able to survive and defend itself than was originally believed.
transcript.zh: 因此，看起来渡渡鸟比人们最初认为的更有能力生存和自卫。

transcript.en: Yet less than 200 years after Europeans first arrived on the island, they had become extinct.
transcript.zh: 然而，自从欧洲人第一次来到岛上不到200年后，他们就灭绝了。

transcript.en: So what was the reason for this?
transcript.zh: 那是什么原因呢？

transcript.en: For a long time, it was believed that the dodos were hunted to extinction, but scientists now believe the situation was more complicated than this.
transcript.zh: 很长一段时间以来，人们认为渡渡鸟是因为被猎杀而灭绝的，但科学家现在认为情况比这更为复杂。

transcript.en: Another factor may have been the new species brought to the island by the sailors.
transcript.zh: 另一个因素可能是水手们带到岛上的新物种。

transcript.en: These included dogs, which would have been a threat to the dodos, and also monkeys, which ate the fruit that was the main part of the dodos' diet.
transcript.zh: 这其中就包括狗，这对渡渡鸟是一个威胁，还有猴子，它吃的水果是渡渡鸟饮食的主要部分。

transcript.en: These were brought to the island deliberately,
transcript.zh: 它们都是被故意带到岛上的，

transcript.en: but the ships also brought another type of creature — rats, which came to land from the ships and rapidly overran the island.
transcript.zh: 但也带来了另一种生物——老鼠，它们从船上下来，迅速地在小岛上肆虐横行。

transcript.en: These upset the ecology of the island, not just the dodos but other species too.
transcript.zh: 这些动物破坏了岛上的生态，不仅仅影响渡渡鸟，还包括其他物种。

transcript.en: However, they were a particular danger to the dodos because they consumed their eggs,
transcript.zh: 然而，它们对渡渡鸟来说特别危险，因为它们以渡渡鸟的蛋为食，

transcript.en: and since each dodo only laid one at a time, this probably had a devastating effect on populations.
transcript.zh: 而且由于每只渡渡鸟一次只产一颗蛋，这对它们的种群可能会产生毁灭性的影响。

transcript.en: However, we now think that probably the main cause of the birds' extinction was not the introduction of non-native species,but the introduction of agriculture.
transcript.zh: 然而，我们现在认为，鸟类灭绝的主要原因可能不是由于外来物种，而是农业的引进。

transcript.en: This meant that the forest that had once covered all the island, and that had provided a perfect home for the dodo, was cut down so that crops such as sugar could be grown.
transcript.zh: 这意味着曾经覆盖整个岛屿的森林被砍伐了，以便种植甘蔗等作物，而这片森林曾是渡渡鸟理想的家园。

transcript.en: So although the dodo had survived for thousands of years, suddenly it was gone.
transcript.zh: 所以尽管渡渡鸟存活了几千年，但突然之间就灭绝了。
